sad-001.voice: God hasn’t heard a single one of my groans.
sad-001.situation: Sadness convincing you that God isn’t listening.

sad-002.voice: God doesn’t see what you’re going through.
sad-002.situation: Feeling that your suffering is invisible to God.

excerpt.to: a land flowing with milk and honey

sad-003.voice: Ever since I got serious about God, things have gotten worse.
sad-003.situation: Troubles multiplying just as you start taking faith seriously.
sad-003.note: Evagrius warns that temptations multiply when someone starts taking God’s word to heart. Moses felt the same.

sad-004.voice: Don’t expect any help from God.
sad-004.situation: Sadness that has stopped expecting God to act.

sad-005.voice: I’m new to this. I’ll be hit with more than I can handle.
sad-005.situation: A beginner’s fear of facing more than you can bear.
sad-005.note: Evagrius reads this as God leading beginners by a gentler road.

sad-006.voice: The enemy doesn’t care that God fights for you.
sad-006.situation: Forgetting that God’s fighting on your side is known and feared.

sad-007.voice: Why is the enemy so set against me?
sad-007.situation: Not understanding why evil seems to pursue you.

sad-008.situation: Fear that something evil will come in the night.

sad-009.voice: No one is helping you. You can’t see any help at all.
sad-009.situation: Terror because the help God sends is invisible.

sad-010.voice: No angel is watching over me.

sad-011.voice: This turmoil at night will never end.
sad-011.situation: Restless, frightening nights that feel permanent.

sad-012.voice: It’s useless to fight. You can’t win.
sad-012.situation: Voices, other people’s or your own, telling you resistance is pointless.

sad-013.voice: A sudden sound startled me, and now I’m afraid.
sad-013.situation: Shaken by a sudden, frightening sound or voice.

sad-014.voice: I saw something terrifying. I can’t shake the image.
sad-014.situation: Terrified by a frightening sight or image.

sad-015.voice: Something struck at me suddenly, but I stayed calm.
sad-015.situation: Thanking God for peace during a sudden attack.

sad-016.voice: I’m frightened, and God has left me.
sad-016.situation: Fear that makes you think God has abandoned you.

sad-017.voice: What’s the reason for all these trials?
sad-017.situation: Wanting to understand why you’re being tested.

sad-018.voice: Something dark is coiling around me in the night.
sad-018.situation: Frightening sensations or images in the night.

sad-019a.voice: Fear jolts me awake in the night.
sad-019a.situation: Sudden sadness and fear in the night.

sad-019b.voice: I want to draw closer to God, but fear holds me back.
sad-019b.situation: Fear keeping you from a deeper commitment.

sad-020.voice: Give your life to God and terrifying things will happen.
sad-020.situation: Hesitating to commit to God for fear of what you’ll face.

sad-021.voice: I’m so low that every night brings frightening dreams.
sad-021.situation: Sadness that leaves you open to nightmares.

sad-022.voice: My body feels cold and tense, and I can’t shake it.
sad-022.situation: Not knowing that singing the Psalms can lift a heavy, troubled body and spirit.
sad-022.note: Evagrius saw that the melody of the Psalms changes the condition of the body and drives off the oppressing spirit, as David’s harp did for Saul.

sad-023.voice: It’s coming at you armed. You’re defenseless.
sad-023.note: Evagrius tells how Abba Macarius answered a sword-bearing demon with these words.

sad-024.voice: Listen to the noise and the voices. You’re surrounded.
sad-024.situation: Unsettled by commotion and voices that seem to come from nowhere.

sad-025.voice: Everyone will laugh at you for exposing all this.
sad-025.situation: Threats of ridicule for speaking openly about your struggles.
sad-025.note: Evagrius heard this threat because he had written down the demons’ tactics in this very book.

sad-026.voice: Something appeared out of nowhere and terrified me.
sad-026.situation: Frightened by something that appears suddenly.

sad-027.voice: There’s no help around me. I’m on my own.
sad-027.situation: Not believing that unseen help surrounds you.

sad-028.voice: They’re coming to fight you. Be afraid.
sad-028.situation: Fear and trembling about an attack that hasn’t come.

sad-029.voice: Disturbing dreams at night, and I feel sick inside.
sad-029.situation: Disordered, dark dreams, brought to God.

sad-030.voice: Run away. Don’t stand and fight.
sad-030.situation: The urge to flee instead of standing firm.

sad-031.voice: Something is about to come at me tonight.
sad-031.situation: Dreading an attack in the night.

sad-032.voice: The noise and chaos are too much.
sad-032.situation: Disturbed by tumult and commotion around you.

sad-033.voice: Something stings my body in the night.

sad-034.voice: Threatening figures appear out of nowhere.
sad-034.situation: Frightening figures that seem to come out of the air.

sad-035.voice: There’s no reason, but I’m crushed with sadness.
sad-035.situation: Heavy, unexplained sadness that weighs on your head and body.
sad-035.note: Evagrius noticed that this sadness needs no thoughts to feed it. It simply weighs on the body and casts the soul into needless distress.

sad-036.voice: I’ve been wounded, and the marks are on my body.
sad-036.situation: Physical harm or marks you can’t explain.

sad-037.voice: One grief fills my whole mind. I can’t think of anything else.
sad-037.situation: A single, overwhelming grief that takes over your mind.
sad-037.note: If one painful thought takes over your mind for days, please talk to someone you trust, and to a doctor, as well as praying.

sad-038.situation: Threatening thoughts of violence in the night.

sad-039.voice: A blow is coming. You’ll suffer.
sad-039.situation: Predictions that punishment or suffering is coming.

sad-040.voice: I’m too sad to find the words to pray.
sad-040.situation: Searching for words to pray in a time of sadness.

sad-041.situation: Burning pain in your body, brought to God.

sad-042.voice: Think of your aging father, your frail mother, your grieving family.
sad-042.situation: Sad thoughts about family that pull at your heart and wear you down.

excerpt.from: His words were softer than oil

sad-042.note: Evagrius hears these gentle, sorrowful thoughts as soft words that hide darts.

sad-043.voice: You’re losing your mind, and everyone will see.
sad-043.situation: Fear of a mental breakdown, and of shaming others who trust God.
sad-043.note: If you fear for your mental health, reaching out to a doctor or counselor is wise. It is not a failure of faith.

sad-044.voice: God has abandoned you. Nobody will rescue you.
sad-044.situation: Hearing the enemy’s verdict that you are forsaken.

sad-045.voice: Horrors seem to crawl out of the walls.
sad-045.situation: Terrifying images that seem to come from everywhere.
sad-045.note: Evagrius says this was the prayer of Macarius the Egyptian.

sad-046.voice: Surely nothing is plotting against me.
sad-046.situation: Not realizing that the enemy schemes against God’s people.

sad-047.voice: Look at these images forming in front of you.
sad-047.situation: Disturbing images forming before your eyes.
sad-047.note: Evagrius says Antony answered such images with this verse.

sad-048.voice: It flares up like fire, then vanishes like smoke.
sad-048.situation: Something frightening that flares up and then disappears.

sad-049.situation: Threats of fiery harm, brought to God.

sad-050.voice: Following Christ is far too dangerous.
sad-050.situation: Exaggerating the dangers of the Christian life to keep you from it.

sad-051.voice: Evil can do anything it wants to me.
sad-051.situation: Forgetting that nothing can touch you without God’s permission.

sad-052.voice: Why is my body suffering now, after everything else?
sad-052.situation: Not understanding why trials move from your thoughts to your body.

sad-053.voice: Lights will appear in the dark and burn your eyes.
sad-053.situation: Fearful predictions of terrifying things in the night.
sad-053.note: Evagrius’s advice for that moment: kneel, keep praying, turn your face away and don’t watch.

sad-054.voice: This will be the death of you.
sad-054.situation: Fear that spiritual attack will end in death.

sad-055.voice: Look at all you’ve done wrong. Stay down.
sad-055.situation: Past sins paraded before you to sink you into sadness.

sad-056.voice: Every time I pray, something attacks and distracts me.

sad-057.voice: What will happen to the evil that torments me?
sad-057.situation: Wanting to know what end awaits the powers of evil.

sad-058.situation: Stunned by frightening flashes and sounds.
sad-058.note: Evagrius says Macarius answered with these words.

sad-059.voice: You’re too weak to go on.
sad-059.situation: Thoughts that feed on weakness and weariness.

sad-060.voice: Your family despises you for not giving them money.
sad-060.situation: Hurt by relatives’ contempt, and finding no comfort from them.

sad-061.voice: What if… what if… what if…
sad-061.situation: Empty, anxious thoughts breeding fear and dimming your peace.

sad-062.voice: Strange flashes of light frighten me.
sad-062.situation: Frightened by strange flashes of light.

sad-063.voice: My mind keeps sinking toward death and dark images.
sad-063.situation: Sadness dragging your mind toward death and disturbing images.
sad-063.note: Evagrius calls this a sign of a soul in danger. If your thoughts turn toward death, please reach out today. The help panel on this page has a free crisis line.

sad-064.voice: Soon you’ll be shamed in front of everyone.
sad-064.situation: Fear of public failure in your life of faith.

sad-065.voice: I feel something touching me, and I’m afraid.
sad-065.situation: Frightened by physical sensations of attack.

sad-066.voice: Evil has power over me and can do as it pleases.
sad-066.situation: Believing the enemy’s boast that it controls you.

sad-067.voice: My heart is full of fear and trembling.
sad-067.situation: Not seeing that weak faith breeds fear.

sad-068.voice: I’ve been humiliated for following Jesus.
sad-068.situation: Sad about being dishonored for your faith.

sad-069.situation: Suffering that seems to come from temptation and serve no purpose.

sad-070.voice: Terrible suffering lies ahead of you.
sad-070.situation: Predictions of severe suffering to come.

sad-071.voice: This is more than I can take.
sad-071.situation: Believing you’re being tested beyond your strength.

sad-072.voice: This trial is beyond words. I feel like I’m dying.
sad-072.situation: An overwhelming trial you can’t even describe.

sad-073.voice: Remember what you did when you were young?
sad-073.situation: The sins of your youth brought back to shame you.

sad-074.voice: Losing this is crushing you, and it should.
sad-074.situation: Grief over passing, worldly things sinking your mind.

sad-075.voice: You’re in open war now, and you’ll lose.
sad-075.situation: Thoughts that come when the struggle is out in the open.

sad-076.voice: You’ll be wounded, and your body will never recover.
sad-076.situation: Fear of lasting harm and incurable illness.
